scope: ActQuant-ON layer-0 Q4 versus the same-build stock-ON graph; not trusted-reference full-model acceptance

isolated_operator_performance.scope: One Qcur-0 matvec dispatch on freshly captured physical-phone ActQuant-ON step16 W/X; quantizer preparation excluded; no model throughput measurement
isolated_operator_performance.metric: (GPUEndTime-GPUStartTime)*1e6 after completion; GPU command-buffer elapsed microseconds

interpretation.C8_status: Isolated research comparison only; no new C8 real-graph/model acceptance

limits: Three rounds in one approximately 2.90-second campaign, not three independent thermal campaigns.
Median per-pair relative changes differ from ratios of marginal medians.
A/A is not subtracted as a universal correction.
Q command-buffer elapsed excludes ActQuant preparation, CPU encoding, full decode and energy.
C8 remains extra isolated research; no new joint real-graph/model acceptance is asserted.

raw_data_policy: Raw arrays, logs, CSV, models, builds and signing/device identifiers remain local. Only derived facts and digests are curated here.
